Part of gross pay.

Annual leave in Oman

  • At least 30 days on gross pay a year; it does not increase with seniority.
  • It cannot be taken in the first 6 months of employment.
  • Up to 30 days may be carried over, and 30 days must be taken at least once every two years.
  • Unused days are paid at gross pay at the end of service, and at basic pay with written consent during service.

Example: gross pay OMR 1,000 (basic 600) and 20 unused days.
At the end of service: 1,000 ÷ 30 × 20 = OMR 666.67.
During service with written consent: 600 ÷ 30 × 20 = OMR 400.

Frequently asked questions

How much annual leave is there in Oman?

At least 30 days a year on gross pay (Article 78 of Labour Law 53 of 2023), and leave may not be taken before six months of service.

Is unused leave paid on gross or basic salary?

At the end of service: on gross pay for your balance. During service, days you have not taken may be paid on basic salary, with your written consent (Article 81).

How many days can be carried over?

An employee may keep a balance of no more than 30 days unless the leave was not taken in the interest of work, and must take at least 30 days of leave at least once every two years.

How much sick leave is there in Oman?

Up to 182 days a year on gross pay: days 1–21 on full pay, 22–35 at 75%, 36–70 at 50% and 71–182 at 35%.

Who pays sick leave since July 2026?

Since 19 July 2026 the employer pays the first seven days and the Social Protection Fund reimburses the employer from the eighth day at the same rates, for Omanis and non-Omanis. The employee's entitlement has not changed.
